implications.statement:
0 < ∑' (j : ℕ), (-1) ^ j / ↑(2 * j + 1) ^ 2 →
  ∑' (j : ℕ), (-1) ^ j / ↑(2 * j + 1) ^ 2 < 1 →
    ∃ f, OAI.Invariant233.Rotation.IsContinuousCounterexample (∑' (j : ℕ), (-1) ^ j / ↑(2 * j + 1) ^ 2) f
implications.derived:
Irrational (∑' (j : ℕ), (-1) ^ j / ↑(2 * j + 1) ^ 2) →
  (∀ (θ : ℝ), 0 < θ → θ < 1 → Irrational θ → ∃ f, OAI.Invariant233.Rotation.IsContinuousCounterexample θ f) →
    0 < ∑' (j : ℕ), (-1) ^ j / ↑(2 * j + 1) ^ 2 →
      ∑' (j : ℕ), (-1) ^ j / ↑(2 * j + 1) ^ 2 < 1 →
        ∃ f, OAI.Invariant233.Rotation.IsContinuousCounterexample (∑' (j : ℕ), (-1) ^ j / ↑(2 * j + 1) ^ 2) f
implications.proof: fun source1 source2 hθ0 hθ1 => source2 (∑' (j : ℕ), (-1) ^ j / ↑(2 * j + 1) ^ 2) hθ0 hθ1 source1
